summary: Test-writing run for issue #39 (red phase). Added: (1) the committed solver-parity corpus fixture byte-identical to viamin/color_matching#111 (sha256 7b7b4d904ff369e1f5be0ec3a994d96cc996056e856d86a2b764b83c050f8604) plus SolverParityCorpusTests replaying all 12 scenarios through WeightedSquaredErrorScorer with exact (no-epsilon) agreement on scores, earliest-wins tie-breaking, exclusions, and weight handling; (2) PaletteAPIClientContractTests pinning the /api/v1 wire contract the generated OpenAPI-client migration must preserve (endpoints, bearer handling, snake_case envelopes, error mapping) so disk-cache/offline-stale behavior survives; (3) OpenAPIDocumentTests asserting the OpenAPI document (viamin/color_matching#110) is committed and covers /api/v1/printer_profiles, /api/v1/colors, and bearerAuth — intentionally red until the implementation run commits it; (4) docs/parity-corpus.md documenting corpus location/refresh and the criterion map.
